family: overnight-equity EVENT anomalies: earnings-announcement nights and post-print event time (SEC 8-K Item 2.02), 52-week extremes, index-add proxy, turn-of-month and FOMC, all on the 15:59 -> next opening auction rail
verdict: NOISE. Nothing promotable and nothing new. 3 of 53 clear the design bar; 2 are T3 restatements (rho +0.94 / +0.99, no residual alpha out of sample); the one structurally new clearer, N07, held out at Sharpe -0.51.

noise_bar.statistic: annualised Sharpe expressed in its own standard-error units (= the t of the mean nightly P&L)

empirical_joint_null.method: within-day permutation of overnight returns among valid names, ONE permutation shared by all 53 configs so their correlation is preserved, max |t| and max |Sharpe| across all 53 per replicate

noise_bar.why: both directions are tradeable so the search is two-sided; t rather than Sharpe because several configs trade only 37-300 nights and dominate the max-Sharpe null without carrying evidence

cost_model.borrow_screen: point-in-time top-500 dollar ADV, price > $5, prior-month ADV > $20M -- easy-to-borrow by construction
cost_model.mirror_rule: a config traded in the opposite direction pays the same cost: net_mirror = -gross - cost, NOT -(gross - cost)

best.name: N07_ann_p10_fade
best.formula: among the names whose SEC 8-K Item 2.02 lands in tonight's overnight window ONLY, cross-sectionally fade the 15:49->15:59 last-trade move: long the bottom third, short the top third, dollar-neutral, marketable entry at the 15:59 print, exit at the next opening auction
best.heldout: -8.04 bp/night, net Sharpe -0.51, t -0.48 over 219 nights; zero-cost Sharpe -0.39; hit rate 61.8% -> 50.7%; residual alpha over the T3 book +29.84 bp (t +2.98) on design -> -15.89 bp (t -0.99) held out
best.diversifying_vs_T3: yes on design (rho +0.30) -- which is why it was the candidate, and it is the one that failed

M03_spy_fomc_eve.what: long SPY overnight from the 15:59 print into an FOMC decision day
why_not_promoted: design t 2.06 never cleared the 3.27 bar
3 of 10 arbitrary placebo lags (k=1,2,5 sessions before the decision) give a design Sharpe above +4.5 on 48 observations; only k=1 replicates
it is the published Lucca-Moench pre-FOMC announcement drift, not an invention
~8 nights a year at ~15 bp, and the best three nights are 55-68% of the P&L

post_print_overnight_underperformance.what: against a coverage-matched control, names 1-5 sessions after an 8-K 2.02 underperform overnight; the effect decays monotonically in event time and does not depend on the surprise sign, so it is attention decay rather than PEAD
post_print_overnight_underperformance.why_not_promoted: gross edge ~2.3 bp/night against 1.63 bp of cost on design, and the gross halves out of sample

confounds_found_and_fixed.name: ETF/ADR control leg
confounds_found_and_fixed.detail: an 8-K 2.02 exists only for domestic filers; 147 of the 500 point-in-time top-ADV names on a typical day (SPY, QQQ, IWM, IVV, VOO, DIA, TQQQ, LQD, HYG, AGG, IEF, sector XLs, KRE, XOP, EWZ, IEMG, VEA, BABA, TSM) can never be an event name, so 'short the rest of the cross-section' was a permanent long-stock/short-ETF factor bet
confounds_found_and_fixed.fix: every event-vs-cross-section book rebuilt inside the point-in-time coverage-matched universe (has already filed >=1 8-K 2.02 by that date)

confounds_found_and_fixed.name: placebo fired pre-fix
confounds_found_and_fixed.detail: 'long names 11-20 nights after a print' came in at t = -4.50 before the coverage fix; post-fix its gross Sharpe is -0.41 against -2.27 at nights 1-5, and the event-time profile is monotone

lookahead_treatment.post_announcement_and_announcement_night: no look-ahead: an announcement night's overnight return is realised at the following open, before the 15:59 entry of the next night
lookahead_treatment.pre_announcement: needs the date to be known at 15:59; issuers do pre-announce, but that is an assumption, so a strictly point-in-time predicted-date variant (last observed filing + 91 calendar days) was run alongside the realised-date one. Both are negative (P02 -1.55, P03 -0.96, P01 -0.74 tradeable Sharpe), and the realised-date version is not better than the predicted one, so the pre-announcement groups carry no hidden advantage -- they are simply empty.

not_testable_on_free_cached_data: index add / delete -- no point-in-time S&P or Russell membership anywhere in cache (t13_cache/sp500tr.csv is an index level, not constituents) and free vendors do not publish historical membership with effective dates; R01/R02 are a top-500-ADV rank-promotion proxy with no forced index-fund demand behind them and must not be read as evidence about index events
secondary / follow-on offerings -- needs SEC 424B filings by symbol and pricing date; would require a rate-limited EDGAR full-index crawl as a detached job

overnight news volume / retail attention -- no daily share-volume series for this universe in cache (t3_cache carries monthly dollar-ADV only; t11_cache/daily_bars overlaps on 56 symbols), so volume conditioners were replaced by same-session move magnitude and trailing realised vol

iteration_ledger.change: 8 new configs (D13-D17, G01-G03), 12 re-parameterised (event-count thresholds, decile cuts, 30-night floor that made the FOMC configs evaluable)
16 event-vs-cross-section books rebuilt on the coverage-matched universe; X01 confound probe added
